package cli

import (
	"bytes"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func zzReport(t *testing.T, root string, args ...string) {
	var so, se bytes.Buffer
	code := cmdReport(root, append([]string{"--task", "probe"}, args...), &so, &se)
	raw, _ := os.ReadFile(strings.TrimSpace(so.String()))
	s := string(raw)
	if i := strings.Index(s, "## Files Changed"); i >= 0 {
		j := strings.Index(s, "## Validation Commands")
		s = s[i:j]
	}
	t.Logf("report %v exit=%d stderr=%q\nMD=%q", args, code, se.String(), s)
}

func zzAll(t *testing.T, name, root, rev string) {
	var o bytes.Buffer
	c := &nativeChecker{root: root, mode: "strict", locale: localeEN, stdout: &o}
	c.readyTransitionCandidates()
	_, err := computeChangedScopeWith(root, rev, "", nil, scopeMetadata{})
	t.Logf("== %s\ncheck errors=%d %q\nscope: %v", name, c.errors, o.String(), err)
}

func TestZZRevName(t *testing.T) {
	root, _ := staleIndexRepo(t)
	zzAll(t, "unknown rev", root, "no-such-ref")
	zzAll(t, "unknown rev containing index", root, "feature/index-rework")
	zzReport(t, root, "--since", "feature/index-rework")
}

func TestZZVariants(t *testing.T) {
	for _, v := range []string{"garbage", "truncated", "badsum", "version", "dir", "mode000", "badconfig", "badhead"} {
		root, _ := staleIndexRepo(t)
		idx := filepath.Join(root, ".git", "index")
		raw, _ := os.ReadFile(idx)
		switch v {
		case "garbage":
			os.WriteFile(idx, []byte(strings.Repeat("g", 200)), 0o644)
		case "truncated":
			os.WriteFile(idx, raw[:len(raw)/2], 0o644)
		case "badsum":
			raw[len(raw)-1] ^= 1
			os.WriteFile(idx, raw, 0o644)
		case "version":
			raw[7] = 99
			os.WriteFile(idx, raw, 0o644)
		case "dir":
			os.Remove(idx)
			os.Mkdir(idx, 0o755)
		case "mode000":
			os.Chmod(idx, 0)
		case "badconfig":
			os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, ".git", "config"), []byte("[core\n"), 0o644)
		case "badhead":
			os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, ".git", "HEAD"), []byte("junk\n"), 0o644)
		}
		zzAll(t, v, root, "HEAD")
		zzReport(t, root)
	}
}

func TestZZLocale(t *testing.T) {
	for _, lang := range []string{"de_DE.UTF-8", "pt_BR.UTF-8", "pt_PT.UTF-8", "fr_FR.UTF-8", "en_US.UTF-8"} {
		t.Setenv("LANG", lang)
		t.Setenv("LC_ALL", lang)
		t.Setenv("LANGUAGE", lang[:5])
		root, _ := staleIndexRepo(t)
		os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, ".git", "index"), []byte("not an index at all"), 0o644)
		out, _ := exec.Command("git", "-C", root, "status", "--porcelain=v1").CombinedOutput()
		t.Logf("--- %s git says %q", lang, out)
		zzReport(t, root)
	}
}

import (

func TestZZPtBR(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("LANG", "pt_BR.UTF-8")
	t.Setenv("LC_ALL", "pt_BR.UTF-8")
	t.Setenv("LANGUAGE", "pt_BR")
	for _, v := range []string{"garbage", "version", "extension"} {
		root, _ := staleIndexRepo(t)
		idx := filepath.Join(root, ".git", "index")
		raw, _ := os.ReadFile(idx)
		switch v {
		case "garbage":
			raw = []byte(strings.Repeat("g", 200))
		case "version":
			raw[7] = 99
		case "extension":
			body := append([]byte{}, raw[:len(raw)-20]...)
			body = append(body, 'z', 'z', 'z', 'z', 0, 0, 0, 0)
			raw = append(body, make([]byte, 20)...)
		}
		os.WriteFile(idx, raw, 0o644)
		out, _ := exec.Command("git", "-C", root, "status", "--porcelain=v1").CombinedOutput()
		t.Logf("--- %s git says %q", v, out)
		zzReport(t, root)
		zzAll(t, v, root, "HEAD")
	}
}

func TestZZNotRepo(t *testing.T) {
	zzAll(t, "not a repository", t.TempDir(), "HEAD")
	zzReport(t, t.TempDir())
	zzReport(t, t.TempDir(), "--since", "HEAD")
}
